about: Rules files at scale: the interim look on the first half and the final analysis (ladder steps, repairs, pooled ladder and position readings per setup), rebuilt from the collected trial rows.

rebuild_only.reason: analyze.ts gained setups_with_rows (the setups that had rows at the look, which plan.ts --interim requires of every setup it plans) after the file was published; the published look was written by an earlier version of the script.

analyze.ts gained completeness.extra_rows (rows outside the plan, which make an analysis invalid) after the file was published; the published analysis was written by an earlier version of the script. The list is empty for this run.
